body:
## The failure mode

`local_tools.get_categorical_mapping(tablename=X)` called **without a value-column keyword returns an empty dict**. It passes `idxvars='Code'` and no myvars, so `df_data_grabber` drops the Label column and the subsequent `.squeeze()` yields nothing.

**Nothing raises.** Every lookup against the empty dict misses, returns `pd.NA`, and the affected column ships **100% null** while the build reports success. There is no signal anywhere — not a warning, not a log line.

## Why this needs fixing rather than documenting

This is the **third** recurrence in a single country:

| GH | what died | fixed for |
|---|---|---|
| #372 / #377 | `region_dict` → Region/Birthplace all NA | 1991-92 only |
| #348 | the 1991-92 `units` decode | 1991-92 |
| PR #673 | region/rural/relationship in the other three GhanaLSS waves | all |

Each earlier fix was applied to **one wave**, via a local copy of the workaround, leaving the pattern live everywhere else. The most recent instance had been shipping since before #372: `cluster_features` dead in three of seven waves, and `household_roster` carrying `Generation`/`Distance`/`Affinity` — **required** columns per `data_info.yml` — 100% null for **56,817 people**.

It stayed invisible because the coverage matrix cannot see it: the wave-slice exemption added in `8dcd2bcb` (correctly) exempts columns populated *somewhere* country-wide, and those columns are populated in the other four waves. Every affected `household_roster` cell graded `sane` throughout.

## Current state

An AST sweep of all `get_categorical_mapping` call sites under `lsms_library/countries/` (a line-based grep is misleading — most calls pass their value column on a continuation line):

| | count |
|---|---|
| total call sites | 77 |
| pass a value column explicitly | 1 |
| pass one via the `**{value: value}` idiom | 69 |
| **pass none → return `{}` by construction** | **7** |

After PR #673 all 7 are fixed, so **zero bare callers remain**. But the function is unchanged, so the next person to call the bare form gets the same silent 100%-null column.

## Proposal

Make `get_categorical_mapping` **warn or raise** when it is about to return an empty mapping *because no value column was requested*. The bare form is never useful — it cannot return anything but `{}` — so this should be a pure improvement.

Open questions for whoever takes it:

- **Warn or raise?** Raising is the repo's "known-bad stays loud" ethos and this call can only be a bug. But it is a library-function behaviour change with 70 call sites across 15 countries, so a `DeprecationWarning` → raise path may be safer.
- Distinguish "empty because no value column was requested" (always a bug) from "empty because the table legitimately has no rows" (possible, and should stay quiet or warn differently).
- `asdict=False` callers get a DataFrame/Series; the guard should be consistent for them.

PR #673 added `local_tools.code_label_map` as the safe helper (passes the value column, and keys the result by **both** the string and int form of each code — both historical bugs were partly key-type mismatches, since `df_data_grabber` stringifies the Code index via `format_id` while callers look up with `int(value)` or `str(value)`). That helper is the recommended replacement; this issue is about closing the footgun itself.

## A second-order lesson worth capturing

Reviving a dead decode does **not** restore data — it starts *trusting* a mapping table that nobody has had reason to validate, precisely because while the decode was dead its contents could not be observed. PR #673's own fix activated a latent error in GhanaLSS's GLSS4 `region` table (codes 9 and 10 swapped against the questionnaire), turning 2,056 people from honest NAs into wrongly-labelled Upper East ↔ Upper West. Any fix of this shape should re-verify the table against a primary source, not merely make it non-empty. Worth a line in whatever guard lands here.

comments.body: PR #1024 (`fix/674-empty-mapping`, `58c394155`) resolves this issue (`Closes #674`, fires on release). The pre-existing zero-row case (a declared-but-empty org table silently falls through the cascade) is a different decision and is split out as #1036.

title: get_categorical_mapping returns {} silently when no value column is requested — third recurrence
